concerns.text: No task is tagged [FR-001] or otherwise linked to the requirement that the system parse SMILES into molecular graphs with the specified node and edge features.
No task is tagged [FR-002] or otherwise linked to the scaffold‑based 80/10/10 split with zero scaffold overlap.
No task is tagged [FR-003] or otherwise linked to the implementation of a <5 M‑parameter GNN using PyTorch Geometric on CPU.
No task is tagged [FR-004] or otherwise linked to the training regime (≤50 epochs, early stopping, Adam, MSE).
No task is tagged [FR-005] or otherwise linked to evaluation of both GNN and linear‑regression baseline with R², RMSE, MAE.
No task is tagged [FR-006] or otherwise linked to Integrated Gradients/SHAP attribution, aggregation into substructures, and reporting of the top 20 substructures.
No task is tagged [FR-007] or otherwise linked to generation of the required visualizations (training curve, parity plot, feature‑importance chart).
No task is tagged [FR-008] or otherwise linked to the end‑to‑end pipeline resource limits (2 CPU cores, ≤7 GB RAM, ≤6 h).
No task is tagged [FR-009] or otherwise linked to detection and logging of invalid SMILES without aborting the pipeline.
No task is tagged [FR-010] or otherwise linked to ε‑clipping of exact 0/1 FQY values.
No task is tagged [FR-011] or otherwise linked to logging of boundary‑value clipping events.
No task is tagged [FR-012] or otherwise linked to detection of unseen atom/bond types and safe skipping during inference.
No task is tagged [FR-013] or otherwise linked to warning when the test split contains fewer than 20 molecules.
No task is tagged [FR-014] or otherwise linked to logging of absolute split counts and scaffold‑overlap statistics.
No task is tagged [FR-015] or otherwise linked to capture of solvent/temperature/method metadata.
No task is tagged [FR-016] or otherwise linked to creation and provenance documentation of the curated fluorophore‑motif reference set.
No task is tagged [FR-017] or otherwise linked to condition‑wise stratified performance reporting.
No task is tagged [FR-018] or otherwise linked to acquisition of the verified FluorDB v1.0 joint dataset with checksum verification.
No task is tagged [SC-001] or otherwise linked to the success‑criterion that the GNN R² ≥ 0.7 and exceeds the baseline by ≥ 0.05.
No task is tagged [SC-002] or otherwise linked to measuring total pipeline wall‑clock time against the 6‑hour limit.
No task is tagged [SC-003] or otherwise linked to measuring peak RAM usage against the 7 GB limit.
No task is tagged [SC-004] or otherwise linked to verification that training and test scaffold sets have zero intersection.
No task is tagged [SC-005] or otherwise linked to the attribution‑validation criteria (≥12/20 overlap with reference set and ≥1.5× random baseline).
